XAUUSD.title: Gold: wave-4 correction (W-X-Y-X-Z) ending — bounce, then the decision at 4084-4200
XAUUSD.count: Wave 3 topped ~5,600. Since then a complex W-X-Y-X-Z correction inside a falling channel. Z = A, B (triangle 4,080-4,240), C in five waves; wave 5 of C reached the W1 -2.5 band / MN +4 median at ~3,490.

scenarios.name: Option 2 — bounce fails at 4084-4200, final leg to the channel bottom
Option 1 — Z ended at ~3,490, wave 5 up to new highs
